decisions.reason: As a multi-model product line on its own webpage that builds directly on the established portfolio, it reflects visible investment and strategic continuity, so management is likely to continue backing it and treat any early weakness as normal market ramp-up.

The building data digital twin service fits the firm's stated direction toward integrated, emerging geospatial solutions, and despite only modest public visibility so far, management would likely justify continued support because of its future relevance and recent launch.

Although only close to rather than fully within the core offer and not prominently showcased, the authentication and identity delegation service still supports enterprise integration needs, so escalation of commitment makes a near-term withdrawal less likely than continued trial and refinement.

An open GIS application development framework is highly consistent with the firm's open, extensible, user-centered positioning, and as a product line it likely required meaningful development effort that management will be reluctant to abandon quickly.

The identity and access service received an explicit launch announcement and is close to the core GIS application stack, so the firm's public commitment and integration logic make continued support more likely than a rapid exit.
